summary:
I re-checked all 15 statuses against main at 15e78e276 in /Users/slimydog/Antiek/platform/.claude/worktrees/ground-main-20260924. All 15 hold. The headline defect is now proven with stronger evidence than the original harness. I bundled the real FloatMenu.tsx and the real useFloatMenuSelection.ts with esbuild and drove them with a real mouse drag in chrome-headless-shell-1243 and in Google Chrome. Clicking Note or Dialogue gives 'sel= null | floatmenu= false | textarea= false', and the same happens when the menu is rendered inside the selection scope, as on /inv. The Write Edit panel dies on the first click into its textarea. Search, which has no textarea, survives as a control. The harness is in /tmp/mothership-ground/island-ask-refute/real/. In Chromium, then, the only island actions that work are Search and Deep-research, and the one persistent island action (Note) cannot be reached. Firefox and WebKit were NOT MEASURED because those Playwright builds are not installed.

Four corrections:
1. Reading's highlight Deep-research (spin-research) creates a ROOT research, not a child. Its only lineage is a 'read-spin' bucket event (books.py:2186-2198, passage_research.py:135-156).
2. PR #3278 is now CONFLICTING, and vitest is still failing.
3. Persisted ChaseThread props also carry parentInvestigationId and reservedChildId.
4. The ReadingCompanion 'Saved chases' plus draft-merge plus source-rewrite vertical is fully unreachable. Its only writer (ChaseThread) always uses an /inv parent, never read-<doc>.

Missed capabilities, most important first:
- **Wrestle** (/wrestle/:documentId) is the only shipped highlight-to-agent loop with a durable anchor. A PDF selection writes a document.region_selected event (region_id, char offsets, bbox), and a docked chat sends distillation.requested scoped to that region. The default-registered wrestling.py worker answers with claim cards, and each claim can be challenged. It renders PDF page 1 only, and its thread id is one per browser tab.
- **'Research this page'** (ResearchThis.tsx, mounted at Reading/index.tsx:504) spawns research without a highlight and shows a visible error.
- **VoiceNote 'Discuss in Thought Partner'** seeds the sidecar through an event bus but never opens it, so the click is silently lost while the sidecar is closed.
- **CommandPalette 'Toggle AI sidecar'**.
- **Server-side grounding**: /thought-partner always retrieves library notes and injects account memory, so the 'contextless' ask already carries hidden context.

A spec author should reconcile the island's anchor and thread model with the existing document.region_selected / distillation schema before adding a fourth store.
